counterfactual_definition: Remove both long profile types; keep equal counts of the three original raw short profiles on every lane, original per-layer compute and bytes, 32 NPU / 8 SSU / 40 GiB/s per SSU. This is a different population, not a result for the original mixed trace.
derivation: For any positive complete quota count q and L layers, total bytes=32*q*L*sum(V). Makespan >= total_bytes/(8*40). Total NPU compute=32*q*L*sum(C). Thus total_compute/(32*makespan) <= (8*40)*sum(C)/(32*sum(V)) = 1/rho.
scope: All reads performed within a nonnegative-time full run; unchanged C/V/counts, no compression or reads cached outside this run. This is a full-run total-byte bound, not a bound for arbitrary intermediate windows or frozen activation deadlines.
